notes.title: Studio Hitsuji @ GDC
notes.content:
Hello! The Hitsuji team is attending the 2024 Game Developer's Conference in San Francisco next week from March 18th through 22nd. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923876/1b3a599811b46bbb1b91319f6ad38e2d4aedfd01.png

The 2024 Game Developer's Conference (GDC) is quickly approaching next week in San Francisco. Each year, developers from all over the world gather to attend GDC as one of the premier industry events for sharing technical expertise, demoing / releasing new games and networking across all game-related disciplines. 

We are excited to announce that the Studio Hitsuji team will be attending GDC 2024 and will be showcasing an exclusive pre-release demo of our upcoming game "Marble Meadows" before we publicly release into Early Access later this year.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2818680/Marble_Meadows/

If you are attending GDC and/or will be in the San Francisco area during that week, the devs will be attending multiple events in and around the SF convention center including:

 The MIX + Kinda Funny (March 18th)
 BIG Fest (March 19th)
 Gameplay Summit (March 20th)

If you recognize us with our sheep-logo feel free to come  and say hello! We would love to talk to fans or fellow game developers interested in learning more about "Marble Meadows" and the other projects we have in development!
